head: 9c3bebd4f6664c035246241f4deee44eb322eef9
claim: All five kits are publishable at 0.1.1 and release lint passes; phone and push are current on npm.

runs.command:
L="$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/release-batch.log"
{
  echo "Release batch capture on head $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  for p in speak approve outbox service share; do
    n=$(node -p "const j=require('./packages/$p/package.json');j.name+' '+j.version+' private='+(j.private===true)")
    echo "manifest: $n"
    echo "  npm registry: $(npm view @byokit/$p version 2>&1 | grep -m1 -oE 'E404|^[0-9.]+$')"
    (cd packages/$p && npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -E 'filename|total files' | tr '\n' ' '); echo
  done
  for p in phone push; do echo "already on npm: @byokit/$p repo $(node -p "require('./packages/$p/package.json').version") npm $(npm view @byokit/$p version)"; done
  npm run release -- lint --base origin/main 2>&1 | tail -1
} > "$L" 2>&1
cat > "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/steps.json" <<'J'
{"target":{"version":"@byokit speak, approve, outbox, service and share 0.1.1"},
 "start":"Branch from main where the five kits were private at 0.1.0 and absent from npm",
 "steps":["Read each package manifest: version 0.1.1, not private","Ask the npm registry for each name: not published yet (E404)","Pack each package without publishing: a 0.1.1 tarball builds","Compare phone and push with npm: same version","Run the release lint against main: ok"],
 "result":"All five kits are publishable at 0.1.1 and release lint passes; phone and push are current on npm."}
J

steps.result: All five kits are publishable at 0.1.1 and release lint passes; phone and push are current on npm.

verdicts.seen: I read all 12 entries: five manifests (speak, approve, outbox, service, share), each with version 0.1.1, private=false, npm registry E404, and a tarball listing (22, 6, 11, 17, 33 files). Two already-published entries (phone repo 0.1.6 and npm 0.1.6; push repo 0.1.1 and npm 0.1.1) match. The final line reads 'release lint: ok'. E404 means the 0.1.1 versions are not yet on the registry, which fits 'publishable'. Nothing shows a contradiction. The outcome names no separate parts that need their own captures.
